docusign.name: DocuSign Integration by LC Bridge
docusign.requirements: HighLevel account and an existing DocuSign account; configured template mappings and enabled workflows
docusign.description: Connect DocuSign agreements to HighLevel contact data, configured follow-up workflows, and completed-answer sync.
docusign.trial: 14-day free trial; no card to start; DocuSign subscription billed separately

community-agents.name: Community Agents by LC Bridge
community-agents.requirements: Marketplace installation in the owning HighLevel sub-account, a member-facing community portal, and a dedicated member login for each AI identity
community-agents.description: AI replies for HighLevel community teams using supplied knowledge, private previews, and member assessments supported by source conversations.
community-agents.usageMetering: 4 times provider cost; included allowance used first, overage billed through HighLevel wallet
